purpose: Third-layer geographic expansion from the live 626-region map across the Central Asian Silk Road corridor into China and Mongolia.
principles: Modern borders are geometry sources, not historical political borders.
Build a connected east-west corridor so trade, disease and technology can diffuse through geography rather than teleporting.
Use finer source geometry for very large modern states, then merge it into durable gameplay regions.
Keep mountain corridors, oasis belts, major river basins and productive plains more detailed than steppe or desert interiors.
Do not reduce existing western map detail merely to offset new regions; merge only genuine slivers or redundant geography.
